{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor motivators''' were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to modify their [[440 Super-Heavy Armored Chassis]], upon which they mounted [[v-188 Penetrator]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] pieces. The repulsor motivators helped to increase the unit's mobility.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
